comments.author: yveldi
comments.body_html: Even though my gut reaction was “Ew, easy mode, unrealistic, kill it with fire”, I love the idea now that I’ve thought more about it: Headshots from bots never feel fair, especially when they are the first bullets to hit you. After all, AI shots are literal random number generators, and there is nothing we can do to counter that - Even if they see only the top of our head down to the eye (which would mean we peeked perfectly), a headshot can still land with quite a similar chance to normal. A human, on the other hand, would struggle a lot more because humans rely on silhouettes for target recognition.
